mapper.sql: a.user_id AS learnerUserId, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.candidate_profile_snapshot_json, '$.userName')), u.user_name) AS learnerName, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.candidate_profile_snapshot_json, '$.userCode')), u.user_code) AS learnerCode, c.organization_id AS learnerOrganizationId, org.org_name AS learnerOrganizationName
mapper.select:
SELECT x.assessment_execution_id AS assessmentExecutionId, x.source_type AS sourceType, x.source_business_id AS sourceBusinessId, COALESCE(e.exam_name, CONCAT(course.course_name, ' / ', ci.item_title), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.snapshot_json, '$.resource.name'))) AS sourceName, e.exam_id AS examId, e.exam_name AS examName, course.course_id AS courseId, course.course_name AS courseName, x.course_offering_id AS courseOfferingId, x.course_item_id AS courseItemId, ci.item_title AS courseItemTitle, c.exam_candidate_id AS examCandidateId, a.exam_attempt_id AS examAttemptId, a.attempt_no AS attemptNo, a.attempt_type AS attemptType, a.attempt_status AS attemptStatus, , a.started_time AS startedTime, a.submitted_time AS submittedTime, a.used_seconds AS usedSeconds, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_attempt_question mq WHERE mq.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') ) THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_answer ma JOIN sts_exam_attempt_question mq ON mq.attempt_question_id = ma.attempt_question_id WHERE ma.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND ma.grading_status = 'PENDING_MANUAL' AND ma.deleted = 0 AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') ) OR a.review_completed_time IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS reviewStatus, a.review_completed_time AS reviewCompletedTime, a.objective_score AS objectiveScore, a.subjective_score AS subjectiveScore, a.final_score AS finalScore, a.is_passed AS isPassed, CASE WHEN a.attempt_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.score_published_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'PUBLISHED' ELSE 'UNPUBLISHED' END AS scorePublishStatus, a.score_published_time AS scorePublishedTime FROM sts_exam_attempt a JOIN sts_assessment_execution x ON x.assessment_execution_id = a.assessment_execution_id AND x.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_exam_exam e ON e.exam_id = x.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_course_offering co ON co.course_offering_id = x.course_offering_id AND co.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_course_course course ON course.course_id = co.course_id AND course.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_course_item ci ON ci.course_item_id = x.course_item_id AND ci.deleted = 0 JOIN sts_exam_candidate c ON c.exam_candidate_id = a.exam_candidate_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN us_sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_org_organization org ON org.organization_id = c.organization_id AND org.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND x.source_type IN ('STANDALONE_EXAM', 'STANDALONE_PRACTICE', 'TRAINING_EXAM')
AND e.exam_id = #{query.examId}
AND a.attempt_status = #{query.attemptStatus}
AND a.attempt_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.score_published_time IS NOT NULL
AND a.attempt_status = 'RESULT_EFFECTIVE' AND a.result_effective_time IS NOT NULL
AND NOT ((a.attempt_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.score_published_time IS NOT NULL) OR (a.attempt_status = 'RESULT_EFFECTIVE' AND a.result_effective_time IS NOT NULL))
AND 1 = 0
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_attempt_question mq WHERE mq.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_attempt_question mq WHERE mq.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') ) AND (a.review_completed_time IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_answer ma JOIN sts_exam_attempt_question mq ON mq.attempt_question_id = ma.attempt_question_id WHERE ma.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND ma.grading_status = 'PENDING_MANUAL' AND ma.deleted = 0 AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') ))
AND a.review_completed_time IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_attempt_question mq WHERE mq.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sts_exam_answer ma JOIN sts_exam_attempt_question mq ON mq.attempt_question_id = ma.attempt_question_id WHERE ma.exam_attempt_id = a.exam_attempt_id AND ma.grading_status = 'PENDING_MANUAL' AND ma.deleted = 0 AND (mq.grading_mode = 'MANUAL' OR mq.question_type = 'ESSAY') )
AND 1 = 0
AND ( COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.candidate_profile_snapshot_json, '$.userName')), u.user_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.learnerKeyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.candidate_profile_snapshot_json, '$.userCode')), u.user_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.learnerKeyword}, '%') )
AND a.submitted_time >= #{query.submittedStartTime}
AND a.submitted_time <= #{query.submittedEndTime}
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.submitted_time, a.create_time) DESC, a.exam_attempt_id DESC
